title: Grilled Eggplant Salad
description: Grilled Eggplant Salad is a Continental salad featuring tender grilled eggplants, fresh vegetables, Kalamata olives, basil, and arugula, tossed in a classic chef's vinaigrette and finished with crumbled feta cheese for a refined restaurant-style presentation.

ingredients.title: For the Eggplants
items: Black pepper, freshly ground – ½ tsp

ingredients.title: For the Salad Mix
items: Red onion – ½ small, thinly sliced
Roasted red bell pepper – 1, cut into strips

ingredients.title: Garnish
items: Microgreens – small handful (optional, for restaurant touch)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Eggplants
steps: Slice eggplants lengthwise into 1 cm thick slices.
Sprinkle lightly with salt and let sit for 10 minutes to draw out excess moisture. Pat dry.
Brush with olive oil, season with salt, pepper, garlic, and thyme.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Grill the Eggplants
steps: Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill until hot.
Grill eggplant slices 2–3 minutes per side until tender with defined grill marks.
Remove and let cool slightly, then cut into bite-sized strips.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Prepare the Dressing
steps: In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, honey, salt, and pepper until emulsified.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Assemble the Salad
steps: In a large bowl, combine grilled eggplant strips, cherry tomatoes, red onion, roasted red pepper, olives, and basil.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plating (Restaurant Style)
steps: On a chilled plate, create a bed of arugula/baby greens.
Place the grilled eggplant salad mixture on top.
Garnish with microgreens and a light drizzle of olive oil.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled as a salad or appetizer.
Pair with grilled meats, seafood, or crusty artisan bread.
Enjoy with a crisp Sauvignon Blanc or a light rosé.

chefTips: For a fine-dining touch, serve with a balsamic reduction drizzle around the plate.
Smoked paprika or chili flakes can be added for depth of flavor.
Pair with a crisp Sauvignon Blanc or a light rosé.
